title: fix(doctor): do not let migrated models.json keys shadow valid shared auth profiles
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Doctor could turn an old `models.json` API key into an agent-local profile that takes precedence over a working shared profile, silently breaking inference and fallback with authentication errors.

Fixes #187680. Thanks @paterskip for the report.

## User Impact

`doctor --fix` and `update repair` preserve effective shared auth instead of importing a competing catalog key. The warning names the provider and shared profile; the original catalog stays untouched.

Existing `:models-json` shadows, including main-agent overrides after shared-store relocation, are preserved. Doctor shows the exact scoped logout command so the operator can confirm the shared account before removing a local credential. The migration records neither a credential-origin receipt nor credential metadata, so the profile name alone cannot authorize automatic removal.

## Why This Change Was Made

The migration previously deduplicated only identical credential values. A different key received another profile ID, and local profiles enter the merged auth store before shared profiles. The migration now uses the existing read-only auth selection owner to detect effective shared credentials, both when collecting catalog keys and at the store update after any repair prompt. Explicit config credential imports retain their existing behavior.

This stays in the existing migration owner and warning recorder, without adding storage, schema, options, or credential deletion. Production delta: +73/-2 lines (net +71); regression-test delta: +75/-2 (net +73); docs: +12. No baseline or allocation changes.

## Evidence

- Real SQLite regression: shared credentials live in `state/openclaw.sqlite`, with separate agent databases. All four new cases fail against base `82777f305ef8cf01d462998707291dd777f2f8a3`: both stale-key cases incorrectly migrate one credential, and existing main/helper shadows emit no warning. All 18 owner tests pass with the fix (33.24 s wall, approximately 9 s test time).
- Required direct/barrel consumer coverage: the owner suite plus `state-migrations.retained-deleted-agent`, `doctor-health-contributions.auth-import-order`, `doctor-health-contributions`, and `doctor-agent-deletion-journal` suites. Final snapshot: 139 tests across five files passed in three wrapper shards (197.17 s total wall). No individual test exceeded 30 seconds.
- Core tsgo and the selected `commands-doctor` test typecheck pass; touched-file oxlint/oxfmt and `git diff --check` pass. The unchanged state-logging test graph emits its advisory 733-root/720 budget notice.
- Both ratchets pass: max-lines has 404 existing suppressions and env names remain 458/458; test lines are 6,267,398 against 6,325,142 (57,744 slack). No exceptions added.
- Madge reports 0 import cycles. The full `check:changed` SQLite inventory was omitted under the lane's local gate budget; PR CI remains broad proof.

Live proof used isolated `HOME` and `OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR`, synthetic credentials, and external service-repair policy. The full production `doctorCommand` completed with repair and noninteractive options, reported the skipped custom catalog credential, and post-repair inspection printed:

```text
PASS: shared SQLite owner; effective custom:default; no local shadow; source bytes unchanged.
```

Exact source-harness commands (the harness calls the complete Doctor command and closes its databases):

```sh
env HOME="$PWD/.artifacts/live-home" OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="$PWD/.artifacts/live-state" OPENCLAW_PROFILE=lane-187680 OPENCLAW_SERVICE_REPAIR_POLICY=external node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/seed-live.mts
env HOME="$PWD/.artifacts/live-home" OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="$PWD/.artifacts/live-state" OPENCLAW_PROFILE=lane-187680 OPENCLAW_SERVICE_REPAIR_POLICY=external node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/live-doctor.mts
env HOME="$PWD/.artifacts/live-home" OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR="$PWD/.artifacts/live-state" OPENCLAW_PROFILE=lane-187680 OPENCLAW_SERVICE_REPAIR_POLICY=external node --import ./scripts/tsx.mjs .artifacts/live-inspect.mts
```

The initial `pnpm openclaw doctor --fix --non-interactive --no-workspace-suggestions` attempt stalled on its own dist-artifact lock; only that owned command was terminated, and the full source command above was used instead. Doctor also surfaced fixture-only model availability notices and an unavailable pre-repair recovery copy caused by the host volume's staging-ancestor permissions; the auth repair completed with exit 0. No external provider request was made.

Review gap: Codex autoreview was attempted on the local candidate against the base above at P2 coverage, but preflight rejected the host's temporary directory as shared scratch even with TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP unset. No independent review result is claimed. The lane's explicit isolation-failure exception leaves final-head review to the lead.
